# Testing and Processing All Data Sets{#ptcld_time}

We'll now process all of the data sets for this study following the methods outlined in the [previous section](#primer). Here, we'll generate the `cloud2trees` output data for each data set where each data set represents a unique UAS flight plan. Remember, the objective of the study is to compare the tree detection and forest structure outcomes across different UAS-lidar flight plan settings.

## Tracking and Raw Data

get a list of the raw point cloud data available and parse the folder names to create a data set with all relevant variables for tracking the different flight setting parameters

```{r}
tracking_df <-
  list.dirs("../data/raw_las/", recursive = F) %>% 
  dplyr::tibble() %>%
  dplyr::rename(path = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    folder = basename(path) %>% tolower()
    # , path = normalizePath(path)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::extract(
    col = folder
    , into = c("agl_ft", "mph")
    , regex = "([0-9]+)agl_([0-9]+)mph"
    , remove = F
    , convert = T
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(agl_ft, mph) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    # convert to metric
    altitude_m = round(agl_ft/3.281)
    , meters_per_second = round(mph/2.237,1)
    # factor
    , dataset_factor = 
      stringr::str_glue("Altitude (m): {altitude_m} | Speed (m/s): {meters_per_second}") %>%
      forcats::as_factor() %>%
      forcats::fct_inorder(ordered = T)
    # , tf = tf=="on"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(agl_ft,mph)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename_with(.cols = -c(path,folder,dataset_factor), .fn = ~paste0("flight_",.x,recycle0 = T) ) %>% 
  # add in flight time from DJI mission flight plan on controller
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::tribble(
      ~flight_altitude_m, ~flight_meters_per_second, ~timer_flight_mission_mins
      , 61, 4.5, 17.5
      , 61, 8.9, 12.5
      , 91, 4.5, 11.5
      , 91, 8.9, 8.0
      , 122, 4.5, 9.5
      , 122, 8.9, 6.5
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      mission_area_ha = 13
      , mission_mins_per_ha = timer_flight_mission_mins/mission_area_ha
    )
    , by = dplyr::join_by(flight_altitude_m,flight_meters_per_second)
  )
# huh?
dplyr::glimpse(tracking_df)
# View(tracking_df)
# names(tracking_df)
# make a function to label the dataset_factor for plotting
dataset_factor_relabel_fn <- function(df,chr_ret=F) {
  if(chr_ret){
    df %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
      dataset_factor = dataset_factor %>% 
        forcats::fct_relabel(
          # ~stringr::str_replace(.x,"m/s", "m s⁻¹")
          ~ stringr::str_replace(.x,"m/s", "m s\u207B\u00B9") %>% stringr::str_replace(" \\| ","\u000A")
        )
    )
  }else{
    df %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
      dataset_factor = dataset_factor %>% 
        forcats::fct_relabel(
          # ~stringr::str_replace(.x,"m/s", "m s⁻¹")
          ~stringr::str_replace(.x,"m/s", "m s\u207B\u00B9")
        )
    )
  }
}
```

let's check out the basic point cloud information from `lidR`

```{r}
tracking_df$path %>% 
  purrr::set_names() %>% 
  # purrr::map(lidR::readLAScatalog)
  purrr::map(function(ff){
    ctg <- lidR::readLAScatalog(ff)
    p <- ctg %>% purrr::pluck("data") %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::summarise(points = sum(Number.of.point.records))
    a <- ctg %>% purrr::pluck("data") %>% sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_area() %>% as.numeric()
    p %>% dplyr::mutate(area_m2 = a, points_per_m2 = points/area_m2)
  }) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "path") %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(tracking_df) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(dataset_factor) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    tidyselect::starts_with("flight_")
    , points, area_m2, points_per_m2
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    area_ha = area_m2/10000
    , dplyr::across(
      tidyselect::starts_with("flight_")
      , as.factor
    )
    , points = scales::comma(points,accuracy=1)
    , dplyr::across(
      dplyr::where(is.numeric)
      , ~scales::comma(.x,accuracy=0.1)
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-area_m2) %>% 
  dplyr::relocate(area_ha, .before = "points") %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(
    caption = "raw point cloud data description"
    , col.names = c(
      "altitude (m)", "speed (m sec<sup>-1</sup>)"
      # data desc
      , "area (ha)"
      , "# points", "points m<sup>-2</sup>"
    )
    , escape = F
    # , digits = 2
  ) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling() %>% 
  kableExtra::column_spec(c(2), border_right = TRUE, include_thead = TRUE) %>% 
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = c(1), valign = "top")
```

## Process Raw Data

first, we'll crop the raw data to the shared overlap to ensure that the denominator when calculating per area metrics such as point density (points m^-2^) will remain consistent for our reported results

```{r, results=F}
# set up dir for clipped
dir_temp <- "../data/raw_las_clipped"
if(!dir.exists(dir_temp)) dir.create(dir_temp, showWarnings = F)

# ?lidR::clip_roi
las_clip_temp <- 
  tracking_df$path %>% 
  purrr::map(function(ff){
    ctg_temp <- readLAScatalog(ff)
    # clipper
    clipper_temp <- las_ctg_overlap_sf %>% sf::st_transform(lidR::st_crs(ctg_temp)) %>% sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_as_sf()
    # clipped dir, fnm
    lidR::opt_progress(ctg_temp) <- F
    cdir_temp <- file.path(dir_temp, basename(ff))
    if(!dir.exists(cdir_temp)) dir.create(cdir_temp, showWarnings = F)
    fn_temp <- file.path(cdir_temp, paste0(basename(ff),"_cropped.las") )
    # clipped do it
    if(!file.exists(fn_temp)){
      cropped_ctg_temp <- lidR::clip_roi(ctg_temp, clipper_temp)
      lidR::writeLAS(cropped_ctg_temp, file = fn_temp)  
    }
  })

# update our tracking data
tracking_df <- 
  tracking_df %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    raw_path = path
    , path = stringr::str_replace_all(raw_path, dirname(raw_path), dir_temp)
  )
```

interesting.

let's now process the un-cropped raw point cloud data since that will most accurately reflect operational usage of the UAS-lidar collection and data processing workflow. That is, it is unlikely that users will crop their point cloud to a specific area prior to processing with `cloud2trees`; rather, they will just process the raw data exactly as it came from the lidar sensor (and processing software like DJI Terra) without cropping first since that is a step that is: 1) generally unnecessary if the flight was planned to cover the specific area; 2) requires additional coding and processing time that is more complex than just cropping the output raster or spatial tree list data to the area of interest in post-processing

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
remove(list = ls()[grep("_temp",ls())])
gc()
```

### Processing Time Testing

To account for operating system background processes and minor CPU variations during `cloud2trees` pipeline execution, let's process each raw point cloud using 5-10 repetitions. Running multiple executions per dataset allows us to establish a reliable baseline distribution of computational runtimes rather than relying on a single, potentially skewed observation. While flight parameters and point cloud density directly drive overall processing load, individual runtimes can be influenced by transient background CPU tasks. Aggregating runtimes across multiple repetitions enables us to evaluate metrics using central tendencies such as medians or trimmed means (discard fastest and slowest prior to calculating mean) to yield a more reliable computational pipeline performance measure

all processing was performed on a standard laptop typical of a geospatial analyst running Windows operating system with an Intel i7-10750H CPU with 6-cores and 32 GB RAM

```{r, include = F, eval = F}
#### get the infernal "norm_las" folder to plot RGB points
n_temp <- 1
c2t_output_dir <- "../data/processed"

# create a data set to track
ptcld_time_test <-
  tracking_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    folder, flight_altitude_m, flight_meters_per_second
    , raw_path
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::crossing(dplyr::tibble(rep_number = c(1:n_temp))) %>% 
  # sort this randomly
  dplyr::mutate(sorter = runif(n = dplyr::n())) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(sorter) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-sorter) %>% 
  # mark last record per set
  dplyr::group_by(folder) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(is_last = dplyr::row_number()==dplyr::n()) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()
ptcld_time_test

time_test_temp <- 
  for (rn in 1:nrow(ptcld_time_test)) {
    # outdir
    c2t_process_dir <- file.path(c2t_output_dir, ptcld_time_test$folder[rn])
    if(!dir.exists(c2t_process_dir)) dir.create(c2t_process_dir, showWarnings = F)
    ##############################################################
    # cloud2trees::cloud2trees
    ##############################################################
      # run it
      # cloud2trees
      cloud2trees_ans <- cloud2trees::cloud2trees(
        output_dir = c2t_process_dir
        , input_las_dir = ptcld_time_test$raw_path[rn] # system.file("extdata", "MixedConifer.laz", package="lidR") # ptcld_time_test$raw_path[rn]
        , accuracy_level = 2
        , keep_intrmdt = F
        , dtm_res_m = 0.5
        , chm_res_m = 0.25
        , min_height = 1.37 # 1.37 = DBH
        , ws = my_linear # a custom function
        ###################################
        # optional parameters to get more tree attributes
        ###################################
        , estimate_tree_dbh = T # TRUE # DBH
        , estimate_tree_type = T # TRUE # FIA type
        # only for the last run we'll get HMD so that the "norm_las" folder is created in the point_cloud_processing_delivery
        , estimate_tree_hmd = ptcld_time_test$is_last[rn] 
        , hmd_tree_sample_n = 111 # doesn't matter unless estimate_tree_hmd = T
        , hmd_estimate_missing_hmd = T # doesn't matter unless estimate_tree_hmd = T
      )
    
  }

```


```{r, results=F}
ptcld_time_test_fnm <- "../data/ptcld_time_test.csv"
n_temp <- 6
c2t_output_dir <- "../data/processed"
ptcld_time_test_track_dir <- file.path(c2t_output_dir, "tracking")
if(!dir.exists(c2t_output_dir)) dir.create(c2t_output_dir, showWarnings = F)
if(!dir.exists(ptcld_time_test_track_dir)) dir.create(ptcld_time_test_track_dir, showWarnings = F)
# create a data set to track
ptcld_time_test <-
  tracking_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    folder, flight_altitude_m, flight_meters_per_second
    , raw_path
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::crossing(dplyr::tibble(rep_number = c(1:n_temp))) %>% 
  # sort this randomly
  dplyr::mutate(sorter = runif(n = dplyr::n())) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(sorter) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-sorter) %>% 
  # mark last record per set
  dplyr::group_by(folder) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(is_last = dplyr::row_number()==dplyr::n()) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()
# ptcld_time_test
# ptcld_time_test %>% dplyr::glimpse()
# process all of the flights n times in a random order and update the tracker
if(!file.exists(ptcld_time_test_fnm)){
  time_test_temp <- 
    for (rn in 1:nrow(ptcld_time_test)) {
    # outdir
    c2t_process_dir <- file.path(c2t_output_dir, ptcld_time_test$folder[rn])
    if(!dir.exists(c2t_process_dir)) dir.create(c2t_process_dir, showWarnings = F)
    ##############################################################
    # cloud2trees::cloud2trees
    ##############################################################
      # run it
      # cloud2trees
      cloud2trees_ans <- cloud2trees::cloud2trees(
        output_dir = c2t_process_dir
        , input_las_dir = ptcld_time_test$raw_path[rn] # system.file("extdata", "MixedConifer.laz", package="lidR") # ptcld_time_test$raw_path[rn]
        , accuracy_level = 2
        , keep_intrmdt = F
        , dtm_res_m = 0.5
        , chm_res_m = 0.25
        , min_height = 1.37 # 1.37 = DBH
        , ws = my_linear # a custom function
        ###################################
        # optional parameters to get more tree attributes
        ###################################
        , estimate_tree_dbh = T # TRUE # DBH
        , estimate_tree_type = T # TRUE # FIA type
        # only for the last run we'll get HMD so that the "norm_las" folder is created in the point_cloud_processing_delivery
        , estimate_tree_hmd = ptcld_time_test$is_last[rn] 
        , hmd_tree_sample_n = 111 # doesn't matter unless estimate_tree_hmd = T
        , hmd_estimate_missing_hmd = T # doesn't matter unless estimate_tree_hmd = T
      )
    
    # tracking
    fpp <- file.path(c2t_process_dir, "point_cloud_processing_delivery", "processed_tracking_data.csv")
    t_df <- 
      fpp %>% 
      readr::read_csv(show_col_types = F, progress = F) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
        folder = ptcld_time_test$folder[rn]
        , rep_number = ptcld_time_test$rep_number[rn]
      )
    # backup
    huh <- 
      file.copy(
        from = fpp # file.path(c2t_process_dir, "point_cloud_processing_delivery", "processed_tracking_data.csv")
        , to = file.path(
          ptcld_time_test_track_dir
          , paste0(
            ptcld_time_test$folder[rn]
            ,"_rep"
            ,ptcld_time_test$rep_number[rn]
            , ".csv"
          )
        )
        , overwrite = T
      )
    
    
    if(rn == 1){
      ptcld_time_test <- 
        ptcld_time_test %>% 
        dplyr::left_join(t_df, by = c("folder", "rep_number"))
    }else{
      ptcld_time_test <- 
        ptcld_time_test %>% 
        dplyr::rows_patch(t_df, by = c("folder", "rep_number"), unmatched = "ignore")  
    }
  }
  
  # ptcld_time_test %>% dplyr::glimpse()
  ptcld_time_test %>% 
    readr::write_csv(file = ptcld_time_test_fnm, progress = F, append = F)
}else{
  ptcld_time_test <- ptcld_time_test_fnm %>% readr::read_csv(show_col_types = F, progress = F)
}
# set processed dir in tracking df
tracking_df <- 
  tracking_df %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    clipped_path = path
    , path = file.path(c2t_output_dir, folder)
  )
```

let's quickly look at the trimmed mean of the total processing time, discarding the fastest and slowest runtimes prior to calculating mean. The total processing time includes the time to process the raw point cloud to generate the CHM, perform ITD on the CHM, and estimate DBH based on the FIA regional height-DBH relationship.

```{r, results=F}
ptcld_time_test %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    timer_total_dbhonly_time_mins = timer_cloud2raster_mins + timer_raster2trees_mins +
          timer_trees_dbh_mins
  ) %>% 
  # remove slowest and fastest
  dplyr::arrange(folder, desc(timer_total_dbhonly_time_mins), desc(timer_cloud2raster_mins)) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(folder) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::row_number() != 1
    & dplyr::row_number() != dplyr::n()
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(
    tracking_df %>% dplyr::select(folder,dataset_factor)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(dataset_factor, flight_altitude_m, flight_meters_per_second, las_area_m2) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = timer_total_dbhonly_time_mins
      , .fns = list(mean=mean,median=median)
    )
    , reps = dplyr::n()
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    # per ha measures
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = tidyselect::starts_with("timer_")
      , .fns = ~.x/(las_area_m2/10000)
    )
    # format
    , dplyr::across(
      .cols = tidyselect::starts_with("timer_")
      , ~scales::comma(.x,accuracy=0.01)
    )
    , dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(tidyselect::starts_with("flight_"),reps)
      , as.factor
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(dataset_factor) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    tidyselect::starts_with("flight_")
    , reps
    , tidyselect::starts_with("timer_")
  ) %>% 
  
  kableExtra::kbl(
    caption = "Data Processing Time Summary"
    , col.names = c(
      "altitude (m)", "speed (m sec<sup>-1</sup>)"
      # data desc
      , "processing repititions<br />after removing<br />slowest & fastest"
      , "Mean<br />processing time<br/>minutes ha<sup>-1</sup>"
      , "Median<br />processing time<br/>minutes ha<sup>-1</sup>"
    )
    , escape = F
    # , digits = 2
  ) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling() %>% 
  kableExtra::column_spec(c(2), border_right = TRUE, include_thead = TRUE) %>% 
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = c(1), valign = "top")
```
